title: Timer and stopwatch
summary: A stopwatch that counts up with start, pause, lap and reset, plus a countdown with a progress ring and an end-of-time flash. Both share one display.

parameters.name: countdown_s
parameters.description: Pre-filled value in the countdown box.

parameters.name: tick_ms
parameters.description: How often the display updates, in milliseconds.

when_to_select: the user wants a stopwatch, countdown or Pomodoro timer
start / pause / reset controls around a time display
when_not_to_select: a counter that goes up on click (that is js_click_counter)
a game clock inside a game
known_limitations: countdown stops at zero with a visual flash; it does not play a sound file (no audio asset is generated)
lap times are session-only and are not persisted
